camel_example: aliyun nlb UpdateServerGroupServersAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Servers.1.ServerType Ecs --Servers.1.Description '后端服务器描述' --Servers.1.ServerId 'i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --Servers.1.Port 443 --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000' --Servers.1.Weight 100 --Servers.1.ServerIp '192.168.6.6' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Modifies the weights and descriptions of backend servers in a server group of a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 更新网络型负载均衡服务器组中后端服务器的权重和描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun nlb update-server-group-servers-attribute --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000 --servers ServerType=Ecs ServerId=i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 Description=后端服务器描述 ServerIp=192.168.6.6 Port=443 Weight=100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServerGroupServersAttribute

fields.help_en:
The description of the backend server.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at sings (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
fields.help_zh:
服务器描述信息。

长度限制为2-256个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、中文、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The port used by the backend server. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter cannot be modified
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器使用的端口。取值范围：1~65535。

该参数暂不支持修改
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The backend server ID.

If the server group is of the Instance type, set this parameter to the IDs of servers of the Ecs, Eni, or Eci type.
If the server group is of the Ip type, set this parameter to IP addresses
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci的资源ID。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en: The IP addresses of servers. If the server group type is Ip, set the ServerId parameter to IP addresses
fields.help_zh: 服务器IP地址。当服务器组为Ip类型时，必须指定IP地址
fields.name: server_ip

fields.help_en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

Ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance
Eni: elastic network interface (ENI)
Eci: elastic container instance
Ip: IP address
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：IP地址
fields.name: server_type

fields.help_en: The weight of the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100. If the value is set to 0, no requests are forwarded to the server
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器的权重，取值范围：0~100。默认值为100。如果设置权重为0，则不会将请求转发给该后端服务器
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The backend servers. You can specify at most 200 backend servers in each call
parameters.help_zh: 后端服务器列表，单次调用最多支持传入200个后端服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, without sending the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新服务器配置信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate this value. Ensure that the value is unique among all requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not specify this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.**** RequestId of each request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: Updates the configurations of backend servers in a server group

JobId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task
